declarative.name: Account information
declarative.description: Denies app access to account information through Windows capability consent.

declarative.name: Activity history
declarative.description: Disables device activity feed collection, publishing and upload policies.

declarative.name: Advertising ID
declarative.description: Disables the advertising identifier for the current Windows user.

declarative.name: App diagnostics
declarative.description: Denies app diagnostic access through Windows capability consent.

declarative.name: Camera access
declarative.description: Denies app camera access through Windows capability consent.

declarative.name: Cloud content search
declarative.description: Stops Windows Search from showing Microsoft account cloud content.

declarative.name: Contacts access
declarative.description: Blocks Microsoft Store apps from accessing the Contacts capability.

declarative.name: Cortana and voice assistant
declarative.description: Disables the Cortana policy for this user and device.

declarative.name: Diagnostic data
declarative.description: Sets the supported diagnostic-data policy values to their minimum level.

declarative.name: Disable Copilot
declarative.description: Disables Windows Copilot through user and device policy. It does not remove installed components.

declarative.name: Documents and pictures access
declarative.description: Blocks broad documents and pictures library access for Microsoft Store apps.

declarative.name: Disable Edge sidebar
declarative.description: Disables the Microsoft Edge sidebar through policy without removing the browser.

declarative.name: Feedback frequency
declarative.description: Suppresses Windows feedback prompts for the current user.

declarative.name: Inking and typing data
declarative.description: Prevents implicit collection of handwriting, typing and contact data.

declarative.name: Location service
declarative.description: Denies device location access through Windows capability consent.

declarative.name: Microphone access
declarative.description: Denies app microphone access through Windows capability consent.

declarative.name: Notification access
declarative.description: Blocks Microsoft Store apps from reading the notification listener capability.

declarative.name: Online speech recognition
declarative.description: Turns off online speech recognition acceptance for the current user.

declarative.name: Radio control by apps
declarative.description: Stops Microsoft Store apps from controlling Wi-Fi and Bluetooth radios.

declarative.name: Store personalization
declarative.description: Disables Windows content delivery and personalized recommendations for the current user.

declarative.name: Tailored experiences
declarative.description: Disables personalised Windows experiences based on diagnostic data.

declarative.name: Background apps
declarative.description: Prevents Microsoft Store apps from running in the background for the current user.

declarative.name: Clear page file at shutdown
declarative.description: Clears virtual-memory contents during shutdown. This improves privacy but can make shutdown slower.

declarative.name: Delivery Optimization
declarative.description: Restricts Delivery Optimization to direct downloads instead of peer-to-peer sharing.

declarative.name: Edge preloading
declarative.description: Prevents Microsoft Edge from preloading at sign-in and remaining active in the background.

declarative.name: Windows Error Reporting
declarative.description: Prevents Windows Error Reporting from sending crash reports while leaving local diagnostics available.

declarative.name: Fast Startup
declarative.description: Disables hybrid shutdown (Fast Startup) while leaving hibernation itself unchanged.

declarative.name: Fax service
declarative.description: Stops and disables the legacy Windows Fax service.

declarative.name: Foreground priority boost
declarative.description: Sets Windows processor scheduling to favor foreground programs.

declarative.name: Game DVR background capture
declarative.description: Disables Xbox Game DVR background recording while leaving manual capture tools available.

declarative.name: Menu show delay: 0 ms
declarative.description: Sets the Windows menu show delay to zero for the current user.

declarative.name: Disable Storage Sense automatic cleanup
declarative.description: Stops Storage Sense from automatically freeing up space on a schedule.

declarative.name: Games task priority boost
declarative.description: Raises the GPU and CPU scheduling priority Windows grants to foreground games.

declarative.name: Disable Widgets feed service
declarative.description: Blocks the Widgets news and interests feed entirely via policy, not just the taskbar icon.

declarative.name: IPv6 stack
declarative.description: Disables the IPv6 stack on all adapters and tunnel interfaces.

declarative.name: Multimedia network throttling
declarative.description: Removes the Windows multimedia network throughput cap. It can increase CPU and battery use.

declarative.name: PCIe link state power
declarative.description: Keeps PCIe links at maximum performance; this increases idle power use.

declarative.name: Power throttling
declarative.description: Prevents Windows from lowering CPU performance for background processes.

declarative.name: Print Spooler
declarative.description: Stops and disables the Print Spooler service. Do not apply when you print or use virtual printers.

declarative.name: Remote Registry
declarative.description: Stops and disables Remote Registry to prevent remote registry access.

declarative.name: Web results in Search
declarative.description: Disables Bing suggestions in Start and Windows Search for the current user.

declarative.name: Reduce shell animations
declarative.description: Disables minimize and maximize window animations for the current user.

declarative.name: Store app auto-update
declarative.description: Sets Microsoft Store apps to manual updates through the Store policy.

declarative.name: Disable SysMain
declarative.description: Stops and disables the SysMain service. Recommended only for SSD-only systems.

declarative.name: Tips, tricks and suggestions
declarative.description: Turns off Windows soft-landing tips and suggestions for the current user.

declarative.name: Disable transparency effects
declarative.description: Turns off Windows transparency effects for the current user.

declarative.name: USB selective suspend
declarative.description: Disables USB selective suspend on AC power while preserving battery behavior on DC power.

declarative.name: Windows Search indexing
declarative.description: Stops and disables Windows Search indexing. Outlook, Start and Explorer search may become slower or incomplete.

declarative.name: Seconds in the clock
declarative.description: Shows seconds in the Windows taskbar clock.

declarative.name: Compact Explorer view
declarative.description: Uses tighter row spacing in File Explorer.

declarative.name: Disable lock screen Spotlight
declarative.description: Stops rotating Spotlight images on the lock screen.

declarative.name: Disable lock screen tips and ads
declarative.description: Removes Spotlight facts, suggestions and promotional overlays from the lock screen.

declarative.name: Disable search highlights
declarative.description: Removes daily illustrations and promotional highlights from Windows Search.

declarative.name: Open to This PC
declarative.description: Sets Explorer to open at This PC.

declarative.name: Hide Chat button
declarative.description: Hides the Chat taskbar button.

declarative.name: Hide Copilot button
declarative.description: Removes the Copilot entry point from the taskbar without uninstalling Copilot.

declarative.name: Hide Home recommendations
declarative.description: Hides recent and recommended items from Explorer Home for the current user.

declarative.name: Hide Task View button
declarative.description: Hides the Task View taskbar button.

declarative.name: Never combine taskbar buttons
declarative.description: Shows a separate labelled taskbar button for each window, including on additional displays.

declarative.name: Search box style: icon only
declarative.description: Sets the taskbar search control to icon-only mode.

declarative.name: Show file extensions
declarative.description: Shows known file extensions in Explorer.

declarative.name: Show hidden items
declarative.description: Shows hidden files and folders in Explorer.

declarative.name: Left-align the taskbar
declarative.description: Moves taskbar icons to the left.

declarative.name: Lower UAC prompt level
declarative.description: Lets signed executables elevate without a consent prompt.

declarative.name: Disable SmartScreen
declarative.description: Stops reputation checks for downloaded and unrecognised binaries.

declarative.name: Virtualization-based security
declarative.description: Disables VBS, HVCI and Credential Guard through policy.

declarative.name: Disable Spectre/Meltdown patches
declarative.description: Overrides the kernel speculative-execution mitigation set.

declarative.name: Bypass TPM requirement checks
declarative.description: Allows future feature updates on hardware below the TPM 2.0 / CPU baseline.

declarative.name: Block Windows Update service
declarative.description: Stops and disables wuauserv, halting all update delivery including security fixes.

declarative.name: Full path in title bar
declarative.description: Shows the complete folder path in the Explorer window title.

declarative.name: End Task from taskbar
declarative.description: Adds "End task" to the right-click menu on taskbar apps, like Task Manager.

declarative.name: Classic desktop icons
declarative.description: Shows This PC, Recycle Bin, Control Panel and Network on the desktop.

declarative.name: Disable mouse acceleration
declarative.description: Removes "Enhance pointer precision" for a flat, 1:1 mouse curve.

declarative.name: NumLock on at startup
declarative.description: Turns NumLock on automatically at every sign-in.

declarative.name: Disable Sticky Keys prompt
declarative.description: Stops the Sticky Keys popup triggered by pressing Shift five times.

declarative.name: Battery percentage in tray
declarative.description: Shows the exact battery percentage next to the tray icon.

declarative.name: Always show scrollbars
declarative.description: Keeps scrollbars visible instead of only while scrolling.

declarative.name: Enable long path support
declarative.description: Lifts the 260-character path limit for apps that opt in (Git, Node, etc).

declarative.name: Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling
declarative.description: Lets the GPU manage its own video memory queue instead of the CPU. Can cause issues on some older drivers.

declarative.name: Windows Subsystem for Linux
declarative.description: Runs Linux distributions natively alongside Windows.

declarative.name: Hyper-V
declarative.description: Type-1 hypervisor with virtual switch management.

declarative.name: Windows Sandbox
declarative.description: Disposable desktop that resets on close.

declarative.name: Virtual Machine Platform
declarative.description: Core virtualization support used by WSL 2.

declarative.name: .NET Framework 3.5
declarative.description: Legacy runtime including 2.0 and 3.0.

declarative.name: .NET Framework 4.8 Advanced Services
declarative.description: ASP.NET and WCF activation components.

declarative.name: SMB 1.0/CIFS File Sharing
declarative.description: Deprecated protocol kept for old NAS devices.

declarative.name: SMB Direct
declarative.description: RDMA acceleration for file server traffic.

declarative.name: Telnet Client
declarative.description: Plain-text terminal client for legacy devices.

declarative.name: TFTP Client
declarative.description: Trivial file transfer for network appliances.

declarative.name: Windows PowerShell 2.0 Engine
declarative.description: Superseded engine kept for compatibility.

declarative.name: Legacy Components (DirectPlay)
declarative.description: Networking layer used by pre-2008 games.

declarative.name: Internet Information Services
declarative.description: Windows web server with management console.

declarative.name: Windows Communication Foundation
declarative.description: HTTP and TCP activation for service hosts.

declarative.name: Print and Document Services
declarative.description: Internet printing and scan management.

declarative.name: Media Features
declarative.description: Windows Media Player and codecs.

declarative.name: Legacy 8.3 filenames
declarative.description: Disables short-name generation for new NTFS volumes.

declarative.name: Large system cache
declarative.description: Biases the memory manager toward file-system caching over working sets.

declarative.name: Last-access timestamps
declarative.description: Stops NTFS writing an access-time update on every file read.

declarative.name: Relax CPU mitigations
declarative.description: Disables Spectre/Meltdown speculative-execution mitigations via FeatureSettingsOverride.

declarative.name: Idle Defender scans
declarative.description: Disables Microsoft Defender's automatic scheduled scans via policy.

declarative.name: System Restore checkpoints
declarative.description: Raises the minimum interval between automatic System Restore checkpoints.

declarative.name: Thumbnail cache
declarative.description: Disables the Explorer thumbnail cache, showing file-type icons instead.

declarative.name: Network Data Usage driver
declarative.description: Disables the Network Data Usage Monitor (Ndu) service.

declarative.name: Compact taskbar height
declarative.description: Uses the smaller taskbar icon size (Windows 11 24H2+).

declarative.name: Snap layouts on hover
declarative.description: Shows the Snap Layouts flyout when hovering the maximize button.

declarative.name: Snap assist suggestions
declarative.description: Stops Windows suggesting other windows to fill the remaining screen space.

declarative.name: Widgets board
declarative.description: Removes the Widgets icon and board from the taskbar.

declarative.name: Widgets news feed
declarative.description: Disables the Windows news-and-interests feed content via policy.

declarative.name: Hide Ask Copilot
declarative.description: Turns off Windows Copilot entry points, including the context menu shortcut, via policy.

declarative.name: Hide Gallery
declarative.description: Unpins the Gallery node from the File Explorer navigation pane.

declarative.name: Manual page file (0 MB)
declarative.description: Removes all system-managed paging files, disabling virtual memory.

declarative.name: Game Mode
declarative.description: Prioritises the foreground game and pauses background work while playing.

declarative.name: GPU Scheduling
declarative.description: Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling — moves queue management to the GPU. Can cause issues on some older drivers.

declarative.name: Mouse Optimization
declarative.description: Removes pointer acceleration and applies a raw 1:1 curve.

declarative.name: Windows AI & Recall
declarative.description: Disables Windows Recall, AI-powered search snapshots, and Copilot AI features introduced in Windows 11 24H2+.

declarative.name: F1 Help Key
declarative.description: Disables the F1 key opening the Windows help browser accidentally. The key still works in other apps.

declarative.name: NIC Power Save
declarative.description: Prevents Windows from turning off network adapters to save power. Improves latency consistency. Not recommended for laptops on battery.

declarative.name: AutoPlay
declarative.description: Disables AutoPlay for all media and devices so Windows no longer prompts on USB/disc insertion.

declarative.name: Thumbnail Cache Removal
declarative.description: Disables automatic deletion of the thumbnail cache on logoff. Keeps cached thumbnails between sessions for faster folder rendering.

declarative.name: Bing in Start Menu
declarative.description: Disables Bing web search results inside the Windows Start Menu search box.

declarative.name: Windows Welcome Experience
declarative.description: Hides the Windows welcome screen shown after updates and sign-in that highlights new features and suggestions.

declarative.name: Sign-in Info After Update
declarative.description: Prevents Windows from using your sign-in info to automatically finish setup after an update or restart.

declarative.name: Sticky Keys Shortcut
declarative.description: Disables the Shift key pressed 5 times shortcut that activates Sticky Keys, preventing accidental triggers during gaming.

declarative.name: End Task in Taskbar
declarative.description: Enables the 'End Task' option when right-clicking on a window in the taskbar, so you can kill frozen apps without opening Task Manager.
